explanation:
[EFFECT] Both holiday and non-holiday hours cluster almost exactly at zero, with essentially no horizontal spread. The model treats holidays as having a negligible effect on predicted hourly demand.
[IMPORTANCE] This is the least important feature and can be considered negligible for planning purposes.
[RECOMMENDATION] Focus operational planning — bike availability and staffing — primarily on the hour of day and temperature, as these two features drive the vast majority of demand variation; ensure full availability during warm-weather daytime hours and scale back overnight and in cold conditions.
